credibilityEvidence: Sec.3-4 method: rebuilds each incident offline plus a matched control missing only the blamed cause, runs 5 current model families
Sec.6 results: 89% of 108 replications reproduce reported harm; 18-33% harm rate with cause vs <=1% without

Sec.7 limitations paragraph explicitly flags publication bias in the incident catalog, the simulated-vs-shipped-product gap (only 10 destructive-action replications also ran in shipped products), and a 5/11 blind-rebuild disagreement rate
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: controlled matched-control design across 5 current frontier models, 108 replications, with the authors' own limitations stated specifically and testably
reproducibilityEvidence: public incident list and replications at rogue-ai.surge.sh

candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: narrow, well-supported claim: most real agent harm in this sample needed no attacker, and a hazard-naming warning reduced it across all five tested models
candidates.primaryLimitation: simulated single-agent-loop environment; only 10 destructive-action cases were also validated in shipped products, so the harm rate may not transfer to real production risk
candidates.hiddenAssumption: that a report-driven offline replication with a matched control captures the same causal mechanism as the original production incident, rather than a superficially similar but differently-caused failure
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: the authors test this directly (89% reproduction rate, matched-control comparison) and disclose a 5/11 blind-rebuild disagreement rate, so the premise is partially verified rather than purely assumed; residual risk concentrates in the 62 attacker-less cases where the 'cause' is inferred from the public report
candidates.presentationReason: method, control design and limitations are stated with explicit numbers
candidates.reason: 方向新意與今日重要性最高的安全論文:把新聞報的 Agent 事故第一次系統性離線重建並配對照組,發現 72 起有實害事故中 62 起沒有攻擊者,是 Agent 照做任務卻忽略平常風險(例如測試庫和正式庫共用)。

candidates.title: Pandora's Toolbox Or Why Agent Safety Cannot Be Verified
candidates.citationVelocity: submitted 2026-11-18; Semantic Scholar rate-limited after retries, inferred 0 citations as a ~4-day-old preprint
communitySignals: HF Daily Papers: not found in truncated API response (toolDegradation: hf-daily-papers-truncated)
Papers with Code: not applicable, theory paper with no code
credibilityEvidence: Sec.2-4: formal reduction from the halting problem showing agent-loop safety is undecidable in general
Sec.5: proof that bounded (finite-context/time) safety is PSPACE-complete, with explicit configuration-based construction
Abstract/Sec.6: explicit counter-example showing safety is not a compositional property
candidates.evidenceMaturityReason: claims are theoretical and the paper supplies full reductions and proofs matched to the claim type, consistent with the evidence-form-matches-claim-type standard for theory papers
reproducibilityEvidence: all claims are proofs; a reader can verify the reductions directly from the paper, with no code or data dependency
candidates.editorialConfidenceReason: the undecidability and PSPACE-completeness claims are standard computability/complexity results applied carefully to the agent-harness setting, with scope (what counts as 'dangerous') explicitly bounded
candidates.primaryLimitation: the practical bite depends on treating a language model plus code execution as Turing-complete; the paper does not quantify where today's real guardrail stacks fall on the finite-vs-intractable spectrum it proves
candidates.hiddenAssumption: that worst-case undecidability over the full space of possible dangerous programs and contexts is the right lens for judging today's guardrail practice, rather than average-case or empirically observed attack distributions
candidates.hiddenAssumptionImpact: even if average-case behavior is what matters in practice, the paper's own PSPACE-completeness and non-compositionality results still hold for bounded, fully-known agents, so the core 'guardrails give only imperfect safety' conclusion survives; only the practical urgency would change
candidates.presentationReason: definitions, theorems and proofs are given in standard notation with explicit constructions
candidates.reason: 跟 ROGUE-AI 形成理論/實證對照:這篇從計算理論證明保證 Agent 安全本質上不可判定、有限版也是 PSPACE-complete、且安全不是可疊加的性質;ROGUE-AI 的多數事故沒有攻擊者恰好是這個理論結果的一個具體例證。
